state.question: Has Ivory Commerce's operating change resolved the question about certificate expiry? Focus on: September publicly served endpoints with fewer than seven certificate-validity days and the change from August on the same endpoint set.
state.gap: September publicly served endpoints with fewer than seven certificate-validity days and the change from August on the same endpoint set.

candidates.title: Ivory Commerce: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: Ivory TLS observation ledger supports a dated assessment of september publicly served endpoints with fewer than seven certificate-validity days and the change from August on the same endpoint set.

candidates.title: Ivory Commerce: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Ivory Commerce's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.

candidates.title: Ivory Commerce: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Ivory Commerce, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of september publicly served endpoints with fewer than seven certificate-validity days and the change from August on the same endpoint set.

candidates.title: Ivory Commerce: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Talia Grove's Dispatch's dispatch on Ivory Commerce, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Ivory Commerce: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Ivory Commerce's strategy in certificate expiry, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Ivory Commerce: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Ivory Commerce features in a field guide to certificate expiry. The worked example draws on a separate setting: a professional training site discusses expiry of course certificates.
